svg.title: A future CPC squeeze changes value without changing subscriber behavior
svg.desc: A paired scenario curve shows probability of clearing a fixed profit buffer and the associated cohort-margin change under increasing future CPC reductions. Conditional what-if for a planned existing-source cohort, fitted on day 119 and acquired day 126. The model applies an additional 0–45% net-CPC drop beginning day 140 and ramping for 28 days. Each point reuses the same posterior draw and random revenue-mark path: contactability, humans, engagement, click counts, purchase cost, send costs and shared uncertainty are held fixed. Only post-shock revenue per human event changes. The blue band is a 90% draw interval for margin; amber shows the paired median margin difference. The probability axis starts at zero and is scaled to the plotted range; exact probabilities are in the table. Scenario probabilities are not a forecast that a given squeeze will occur.
